plain: Amounting to the same thing as

webster.text: Equal; equivalent in value or signification; as a sum tantamount to all our expenses.

example.quote: Therefore, to have required the ratification of all the thirteen states would have been tantamount to returning without having done any thing.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 4, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
